meta.name: tests
meta.description: Test style guidelines including naming conventions, mock organization, translation handling, and file structure. Use when writing or organizing tests in the Trezor Suite codebase.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按规范编写和组织测试代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Trezor Suite 项目中编写或组织测试
copy.tagline_en: Write and organize tests following style guidelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write or organize tests in the Trezor Suite codebase

howto.what: 当你在 Trezor Suite 代码库中编写或组织测试时，Claude 会遵循测试风格指南，包括使用翻译 ID 而非文字、命名约定、mock 组织方式和类型测试规则。
howto.when: 当你在编写或组织测试时，尤其是涉及命名、mock、翻译处理或文件结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个测试用例，用翻译 ID 获取文本。
为这个模块创建一个 mock 工厂函数。
say.note: Claude 会按照 mock 组织规范生成。

howto.what_en: When writing or organizing tests in the Trezor Suite codebase, Claude follows test style guidelines: use translation IDs instead of literal text, adhere to naming conventions, organize mocks properly, and follow type-test rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing or organizing tests, especially regarding naming, mocks, translation handling, or file structure.

say_en.text: Write a test case using a translation ID to get text.
say_en.note: Claude will use getTranslation function instead of literal text.

say_en.text: Create a mock factory function for this module.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the mock organization conventions.
